plan: Scale every quantity by target_yield/original yield using Fraction; substitution quantity_factors multiply on top of the scale.
Select substitutions deterministically by minimizing (priority, catalog index) among entries whose 'for' matches the ingredient name.
Resolve each ingredient with a substitution loop guarded by a per-chain seen-name set to detect cycles; unresolvable exclusions record 'no substitution for NAME'.
Feed substitution-introduced additional ingredients through a worklist so they receive the same scaling, exclusion checks, and catalog choices (chained adaptation, reintroduced exclusions).
Accumulate wording-change pairs and replay them over copied instruction strings; apply equipment additions/removals to a working equipment list.
Always run the equipment availability check; collect all reasons in a set and only decide possibility at the end, returning sorted reasons and null recipe if any exist.
Build all outputs from fresh dicts/copies so inputs are never mutated; print_original returns authored_text unchanged.
mechanisms: Fraction yield-ratio scaling applied uniformly to authored, additional, and component ingredients
(priority, catalog-index) minimization for deterministic substitution choice
per-ingredient substitution chain with seen-set cycle detection
worklist propagation of additional ingredients through the same exclusion/substitution pipeline
accumulated wording-change pairs replayed over copied instruction strings
working equipment list with add/remove effects, then sorted-dedup and availability validation
exhaustive reason set (no-substitution, cycle, equipment) sorted at return; possibility decided last
copy-on-build outputs with authored_text passthrough for byte-exact original printing
